# Personal Preferences

## General principles

- Prefer single source of truth — avoid duplicating instructions or config across memory files, CLAUDE.md, and settings to prevent unexpected behavior.


## New Task workflow

When a prompt begins with **"New Task:"** or **"new-task"**, treat it as a scoped feature addition, feature change, or bug fix.

- Summarize the ask in 2–3 concise bullet points
- Flag any ambiguity and ask for clarification if needed
- Wait for confirmation before writing any code

## Quick Task workflow

When a prompt begins with **"quick-task"**, treat it as a small, focused change.

- Still confirm the right approach before coding — don't just take the fastest path
- Avoid spaghetti code; prefer idiomatic, clean solutions
- Keep the confirmation brief (1–2 lines), then proceed
